name: BLORB
description:
Blorb is a community memecoin built around a chaos-blob mascot. Blorb is curious, loud, and always in trouble. The project is culture-first: memes, character, and the Blorb World Order. $BLORB has a 1B supply and 0/0 tax. No complex utility claims — just a recognizable blob, a growing pack, and a simple token people can trade and meme.

Blorb is unique because of the character, not a recycled animal meme. Blorb is a chaos blob: curious, loud, and always in trouble. That gives the project a clear look, voice, and story. The brand is simple: one mascot, one world (Blorb World Order)
